Today, Apple TV released the trailer for the fifth season of the award-winning children's mindfulness animated series "Stillwater," which has previously won Peabody and Emmy awards. Watch the video below.

Stillwater Season 5 returns on August 21

A few days ago, Apple TV confirmed the premiere date for Season 5 of "Stillwater," with five episodes dropping all at once on August 21.

According to Apple TV, the new season of "Stillwater" will feature more "breathing exercises, mindfulness moments, and simple everyday life practices," continuing to help children and families find inner calm.

"Stillwater" originally premiered on Apple TV in 2020, and has since won the Daytime Emmy Award for Outstanding Editing for a Preschool Animated Program as well as a Peabody Award in the children's and youth programming category.
